content.short: OtterSec is a blockchain smart contract auditing company, securing top protocols across chains.
content.description: Projects deployed without audits are highly susceptible to hacks and exploits. OtterSec's expert security researchers with white hat experience provide a quality assessment of your code, remediate any possible exploits, and provide in-depth suggestions to improve the code.

resources.title: How We Broke Exchanges Through OAuth Misconfigurations
resources.tldr: Account takeover via OAuth flaws found repeatedly in audits, plus the client-side bugs that sit alongside them.

resources.title: A 12-Year-Old g++ Bug That Took Down Solidity
resources.tldr: Compilers are not supposed to crash on valid code. This one did, because of a defect that had been sitting in g++ for over a decade.

resources.title: How to Survive Supply-Chain Attacks
resources.tldr: The NPM compromise that shipped malicious versions of widely used packages, and what a team can actually do about its dependencies.
